short_description: Consumer-facing fitness trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for right-hand grip-strength tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing strength trait describing a cautious inherited signal related to right-hand grip strength relative to the current local reference panel.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with right-hand grip-strength tendency, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: This is a cautious panel-relative strength signal, not a direct measurement of your current right-hand grip strength. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a direct readout of current strength, gym performance, injury recovery, or athletic ability.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
Current grip strength depends strongly on training, injury, hand dominance, occupation, age, body size, pain, and health status.
This trait should not be used as a rehab, neurology, or sports-performance assessment.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
